_meta.purpose: Response payload when an identity µservice WebAuthn verification resolves a credential to multiple tenant memberships. Drives the dual-tenant context-picker UX per ADR-0311 §B-8.
industry_citations: Apple Managed Apple ID vs Personal Apple ID dual-context

webauthn_credential_id.description: The opaque credential id that resolved across the tenants. Stable across both tenant memberships per ADR-0188 §D-credential-handle-roster.

tenants.description: List of tenant memberships discovered for this credential. When only one tenant is found, the regular SessionToken is returned instead.

tenant_id.description: The canonical tenant identifier per ADR-0244.

display_name.description: Human-readable tenant name for the picker UI.

tenant_class.description: Classification for the picker UI to render badge colors per ADR-0311 §B-8.

cell_id.description: The cell the tenant lives in per ADR-0248.

audience_type_options.description: Possible audience-type values the user can assume in this tenant. Per ADR-0244 §audience_type extension.

preselected.description: MUST be null. Per ADR-0311 §B-8 UX invariant: no auto-selection. The user must consciously pick.
